resources.string: Terminal Plus uses Android Virtualization Framework without root. Use a running Shizuku to configure permissions, or run these two commands once from an ADB computer and tap Check again:\n\n%1$s
Check again
This device does not provide Android Virtualization Framework. Terminal Plus requires AVF and custom non-protected VM support.
This ROM restricts the native VM display to system apps. The two AVF grants enable the terminal, but do not unlock this display service.
Configure with Shizuku
Install and start Shizuku, then return and tap Configure with Shizuku again. You can also copy the ADB commands below.
Please update Shizuku and try again.
